visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a beige two-piece fitness set, sits on a Pilates reformer carriage. She holds a horizontal wooden bar with both hands at shoulder height. The setting is a bright, white-walled studio with large mirrors reflecting the room and equipment. (2) She slowly begins to roll her spine backward, transitioning from a seated position to a reclined one while keeping her legs extended straight. Her expression is focused. A blue yoga ball is visible in the background. (3) The woman lies flat on the reformer carriage, reaching her arms back while still holding the bar. The studio lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clean textures of the equipment and the floor. (4) She engages her core to curl back up to the starting seated position. The sequence repeats in a looped fashion with white Traditional Chinese text overlays appearing in the center of the frame throughout the exercise.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 越忙 越需要運動把自己找回來。. (2) [Slogan]: 生活再快，也要為自己留點力量. (3) [Slogan]: 呼吸、專注、節奏. (4) [Slogan]: 健康，是最穩定的複利

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman in her 20s or 30s with short brown hair, wearing a beige sports bra and matching high-waisted leggings.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A professional Pilates studio with white walls, light wood flooring, large mirrors, and multiple reformers. A bright blue yoga ball sits on the floor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy pop track featuring a fast 160 BPM electronic drum beat. A female voice is heard chanting 'Ap-a-teu' rhythmically. The sound is clean, bright, and possesses a strong dance-oriented pulse with no background noise. (2) The track transitions into a verse with alternating male and female vocals. The music texture remains dense with synthesizers and a sharp snare drum. The vocal delivery is upbeat and energetic. No speech or SFX are present. (3) The chorus swells with layered vocal harmonies and high spectral brightness. The percussive beat continues consistently throughout the timeline. The master track exhibits a compressed, broadcast-ready dynamic range typical of modern pop music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide lifestyle inspiration and promote a healthy mindset. The video uses the rhythmic, repetitive motion of a Pilates exercise paired with upbeat music and motivational slogans to encourage viewers to prioritize fitness despite a busy life.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video is a typical fitness 'mood' clip common on social media, using a high-energy trending song to contrast with the slow, controlled movements of Pilates.
